title: EMA Trend Gate on SOL - Volatility Edge Extension
objective: Extend EMA Trend Gate strategy (0.528 OOS Sharpe on ETH with 1216 trades) to SOLUSDT. Hypothesis: SOL's higher volatility than ETH should generate more trade opportunities and potentially better risk-adjusted returns.
hypothesis: SOL's higher volatility will produce more trade signals (exceeding ETH's 14.3 avg trades/window) with comparable or better risk-adjusted returns. If SOL underperforms ETH, it tests whether volatility alone is insufficient without underlying trend quality.
strategy_rationale: The EMA Trend Gate strategy on ETH demonstrated 0.528 OOS Sharpe with high trade frequency (1216 total trades). This experiment tests whether the same strategy architecture generalizes to another volatile altcoin (SOL) or if ETH's results were asset-specific.
notes: SOL significantly outperformed ETH on OOS Sharpe (1.373 vs 0.528)
SOL generated slightly more trades per window (15.35 vs 14.3)
Max drawdown similar between SOL (-16.84%) and ETH (-16.37%)
Strategy generalizes well to SOL - validates volatility-driven mean-reversion hypothesis
